title: The Sunken Submarine
physical_identity: The sunken nuclear submarine USS Ace of Spades (SSN 744) on the floor of a rocky valley ~600 m deep in an endless ocean; interior intact and lit.
scale_topology: One finite submarine hull (Los Angeles-class layout plus windows) in an unexplored endless ocean; escape hatch at top.
anomalies: anyone outside over ten minutes is sent to Level 7
lighting_sound: Interior lights work; outside poor visibility due to depth; hull creaks and rhythmic tapping from the Great Observer.

entities.name: The Great Observer
entities.behavior: Huge passive squid-like; rocks sub, taps hull, peers in windows

entities.name: The Crew of the USS Ace of Spades
entities.behavior: 20-100 friendly wanderers, trade, show the exit

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Great Observer (passive)
hazards: leaving the sub: transported to Level 7 after ten minutes
items_communities: fridges with water, sandwiches, pasta, fruit, vegetables, eggs, meat
pirate drawings and post-it instructions signed Kira

entrances.method: dive deep and pass out, wake in a berth bed
entrances.quote: they will pass out and wake up in Level 83 in one of the beds

exits.method: undo the escape hatch and swim out
exits.conditions: also forced after more than ten minutes outside
exits.quote: undo the escape hatch at the top of the vessel and swim out into the ocean
find an exit to Level 8 or swim up to the surface

signature_mechanic: Safe, stocked submarine refuge at depth watched by a gentle giant squid; the only way out is the hatch into Level 7 water.
verticality: Within one hull; hatch at top; seabed ~600 m deep not explored.
conflicts_notes: Page flagged outdated. Infinite supplies vs the crew entry says supplies feed only up to 100 people. Intro says 84th level.

key_quotes.quote: in the middle of what seems to be an endless ocean
infinite supply of food and water
transported to Level 7 as soon as they spend more than ten minutes outside
undo the escape hatch at the top of the vessel and swim out into the ocean
